statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was ordered to capture and correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The claim was denied with reason code CO-50
The provided records fail to demonstrate the requisite medical necessity
The records lack evidence of symptomatic arrhythmia
The records lack evidence of inadequate diagnostic yield from prior standard monitoring modalities
